name: Infallible Ailment Sense
description: By examining a patient's symptoms, unerringly diagnoses any physical illness she is familiar with (mental illness requires 30 minutes and a Perception + Medicine roll). Does not improve actual medical knowledge; unknown diseases can only be typed generally and gauged magical or not. She can diagnose her own physical diseases but not evaluate her own mental health.

name: Contamination of Body
description: The Body permutation of Contamination of (Form): temporarily infects a target within three yards with a physical disease. The player picks a plague (core pp.319-321) and rolls Intelligence + Medicine (difficulty = Virulence -1, min 1); on success the target rolls Stamina + Resistance to resist. The illness is noncommunicable.

name: Contamination of Mind
description: The Mind permutation of Contamination of (Form): inflicts a derangement. Pick a derangement (core p.281) and roll Manipulation + Medicine (difficulty 3); on success the target succumbs unless his player makes a Willpower roll vs the Abyssal's permanent Essence. The madness lasts Manipulation days.

name: Contamination of Spirit
description: The Spirit permutation of Contamination of (Form) (only learnable after mastering the Body and Mind forms): roll Conviction + Medicine, resisted by the victim's Valor + Essence; win and the target falls to soul-numbing despair — cannot regain Willpower and suffers -2 to all pools. This soul rot is not a derangement and resists mundane/mind-targeting cures; once per day the victim rolls Willpower vs the Abyssal's Essence to recover. Mortals afflicted past their Valor in days commit suicide.

name: Rampant Pestilence Method
description: Duplicates Contamination of Body but the plague is more deadly and resistant (+1 difficulty to any Endurance/Resistance/Medicine roll to fight or treat it) and is contagious, spreading by all the disease's usual vectors until the Abyssal releases the committed Essence. Abyssals are immune to plagues they create, but their fellows and allies are not — Plague does not distinguish friend from foe.

name: Taint Extraction Technique
description: Expunges disease from his flesh or another's with a touch: the excised taint bursts out as viscous sludge, curing all infected wounds and all diseases whose Difficulty to Treat is at or below the Exalt's Medicine (even the Great Contagion). The violent expulsion inflicts Untreated-Morbidity lethal levels (soaked only by Stamina).

name: Unsurpassed Plague Kiss
description: Unleashes a weaker, noncommunicable strain of the Great Contagion with a simple touch: the victim reflexively rolls Stamina + Resistance at difficulty 5; on failure, roll one die — if it is at or below her permanent Essence she survives with minor fever, otherwise she dies painfully after Stamina days. Survivors become immune to all strains of the Great Contagion.

name: Flesh-Mending Discipline
description: Forces the undesired taint of injury from his body, repairing broken bones and torn flesh: heals bashing and lethal at 10 times the normal rate. Does not regenerate amputated/destroyed tissue nor speed anyone else's healing. Activatable at any time, even unconscious.

name: Touch of Gentle Repose
description: Grants a welcome release from suffering to a willing individual: he lays hands on the subject and whispers a prayer to the Malfeans; if the patient truly wishes to die she may spend 1 Willpower to painlessly end her own life. The choice cannot be coerced. Subjects never rise as hungry ghosts (but are no more or less likely to linger as actual ghosts). Cannot be used on oneself.

name: Blood Mastery Technique
description: Transcends blood loss: she can reflexively stanch her wounds without a roll, even unconscious — flesh contracts and reabsorbs spilled blood, sealing the injury within instants. Does not speed healing, only prevents further bleeding damage. Cannot mitigate Abyssal Caste Mark stigmata.

name: Crimson Waterfall Attack
description: Aims blows at an enemy's arteries: a lethal attack that also makes the victim bleed profusely — all rolls to stanch the bleeding are at +(permanent Essence - target's Essence) difficulty, and the victim suffers one unsoakable lethal level every minute. Characters with Blood Mastery Technique are immune. May be Comboed with Charms of other Abilities.

name: Winter Strikes the Forest
description: Infuses a target with corrosive entropy: for a full day the target heals all injuries at one-tenth normal rate (apply the reduction to any magically increased rate — e.g. a Solar's 10x becomes normal). Delivered by a hand-to-hand attack or any other touch. Once per turn. May be Comboed with Charms of other Abilities.

name: Wound-Absorbing Method
description: Channels Essence into his wounds, drawing them closed: per 2 motes, convert one lethal level into a bashing level. Essence 3+ may also heal others (painfully; UnExalted lose Willpower equal to levels converted unless anesthetized).

name: Fivefold Wound-Absorbing Method

cost.raw: 4 motes and 1 Willpower per health level

description: Turns his most grievous wounds into lesser ones: per 5 motes, convert one aggravated level into a lethal level (which then heals normally). Alternately, regenerate destroyed tissue: eyes/tongues/hands/feet/smashed teeth are one health level each, lost limbs two; regrowth is continuous but not instant (one hour per health level).
